subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

His successful as a lawyer / grew so fast that he soon had / enough money to buy a house.

options.text: grew so fast that he soon had
enough money to buy a house

solution:
The correct answer is 'His successful as a lawyer.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in 'His successful as a lawyer' of the sentence.
 
• The word '**successful**' means '**having achieved** what you wanted; having become popular, rich, etc.'
 
 
• *Example: It was a successful tournament for Team India.*
 
 
 
• Whereas the word '**success**' means '**the fact** that you have achieved what you want.'
 
 
• *​Example: Hard work is the key to success.​*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the use of 'successful' in the sentence should be replaced with 'success' to make it grammatically correct.

 

Correct sentence__: *His __**success**__ as a lawyer grew so fast that he soon had enough money to buy a house.*
